0022600136.text: The Orlando Magic (1-2, 1-0 on the road, 4th in the Southeast, 10th in the East) visit the Toronto Raptors (2-1, 1-0 at home, 3rd in the Atlantic, 5th in the East), with Orlando on a one-game winning streak and Toronto on a one-game losing streak. Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), while Toronto is without Brandon Ingram (Achilles, surgery), Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation), and Nate Bittle (foot fracture). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Magic lost their 2025-26 season series 1-2, including a 139-87 loss in Toronto on March 29, 2026.
